results.description: 14 years after Osakis sued the state over phosphorus limits, they’re breaking new ground.

results.title: Grepow Advances Next-Gen Energy Transition with Commercial Launch of High-Performance Sodium-Ion Pouch-Cell Platform
results.description: Livermore, California, United States, November 12, 2026 -- On Nov. 12, 2026, Grepow, a rechargeable cell and battery solutions manufacturer, introduced its all-new sodium-ion pouch-cell platform comprising five models. With capacities ranging from 2.0 Ah to 7.0 Ah, the cells are designed for low-temperature performance, high-rate pulse power, and flexible pack integration. The launch marks Grepow’s transition from technical validation toward commercial deployment of a multi-model sodium-ion
